pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The patches exhibit highly irregular, stellate geometry with sharp, jagged edges and significant angularity. Dark pigmentation is concentrated in the center of the patches, fading slightly at the periphery where it meets the corridor nodes.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The network of light-colored pelage forms a continuous, multi-nodal graph. Thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform, though narrowing occurs at the vertices of the more acute patch angles.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The contour is dense and relatively uniform without significant variation in height across the visible segment.

other_distinctive_markers: The patches display a high-contrast, near-black coloration in their interior, which is distinct against the light cream-colored inter-patch spaces.
